{"arguments":"","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.current_school_id()
 RETURNS uuid

  WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid())

{"arguments":"p_school_id uuid, p_roles text[]","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_school_role(p_school_id uuid, p_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles
    WHERE id = (SELECT auth.uid())
      AND school_id = p_school_id
      AND role = ANY(p_roles)
  );
$function$
"}

{"arguments":"p_school_id uuid","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_school_member(p_school_id uuid)

{"arguments":"p_school_id uuid, p_class_name text","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_teacher_assigned_to_class(p_school_id uuid, p_class_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.teacher_class_assignments a
    JOIN public.teachers t ON t.id = a.teacher_id
    WHERE a.school_id = p_school_id
      AND a.class_name = p_class_name
      AND t.profile_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
      AND t.school_id = a.school_id
  );
$function$
"}
